prompt: Add a validatePassword(password) function to packages/shared/src/index.js that returns true only when the password is at least 8 characters long. Export it alongside validateEmail and Logger.
rationale: Small, reusable validator added to an existing shared utility module.

prompt: In packages/web/src/App.tsx, handleSubmit calls validateEmail(email) directly. validateEmail's regex is anchored, so an email with leading or trailing whitespace (e.g. from a pasted value) is wrongly rejected as invalid. Trim the value before validating.
rationale: Real anchored-regex whitespace bug in a copy/paste-prone form field.

checks.command: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('packages/web/src/App.tsx','utf8'); const ok=/validateEmail\(email\.trim\(\)\)/.test(s)||/const\s+\w+\s*=\s*email\.trim\(\)/.test(s); if(!ok){console.error('trim fix not detected');process.exit(1)}"

prompt: POST /signup in packages/api/src/index.js accepts any valid email repeatedly with no duplicate check and no persistence at all. Add a small in-memory store to packages/shared (e.g. a createUserStore() factory exporting { addUser(email), hasUser(email) }), wire packages/api to use it, and reject a second signup with an already-used email with 409 { error: 'email already registered' }, logging rejections via the existing Logger.
rationale: Cross-package (shared + api) feature requiring real persistence-shaped state, verified end-to-end over HTTP.

prompt: Add a GET /health route to packages/api/src/index.js returning { status: 'ok', service: '@mono/api' }, using the existing Logger from @mono/shared to log each health check at info level.
rationale: Cross-package feature exercising the shared Logger, verified with a real HTTP request.
